_doc: CONTENT-DRIFT-1 (2026-11-25): systems that write their own content (STATIC-CONTENT-1) can drift into empty, cut-off, templated or duplicate entries with no person reading them. foundation/contentdrift.py --live reads the newest entries of every content_feed in instances/ultrastable/progress.json and fails when the share of bad entries is above max_bad_share or a feed cannot be read. Consumers: foundation/contentdrift.py, doctrine/detectors.json (content-drift), tests/foundation/test_contentdrift.py. Placeholders match case-sensitively and as whole words, so 'maintenance' never reads as NaN.
